basic_details.job_title: DCCM Virudhunagar Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

age_limit.details: The candidate should not have completed 40 years of age as on the last date of application.

qualification.details: The candidate should possess basic typing skills in both Tamil and English. Candidates having at least one year of relevant work experience preferably in a Government Department / Government Office may be given preference. Experience in Data Entry and Data Management. Experience in official file maintenance, record keeping and documentation. Ability to prepare official reports, letters, statements and PowerPoint presentations. Experience in data compilation, tabulation and office documentation. The candidate should be a resident of Virudhunagar District.

salary_details.details: The official notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

selection_process: Eligible candidates will be shortlisted based on the prescribed eligibility criteria and will be called for Typing Test and Personal Interview. A waiting list of 2–3 candidates will also be maintained as per the Guidelines.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility criteria for the Technical Assistant post as outlined in the official notification.

Prepare the application form along with self-attested copies of certificates relating to educational qualification, work experience (if any), typing qualification/skill (if any), and other relevant documents.
Send the scanned application and documents by E-mail to [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the specified email address on or before 20.10.2026.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely contractual for a period of 19 months under the District Climate Change Mission, Virudhunagar District. The engagement does not confer any right for regular appointment under the Government. The selected candidate shall comply with the terms and conditions prescribed by the Department of Environment and Climate Change. The selected candidate shall maintain regular attendance and perform duties assigned by the District Climate Change Mission. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the typing test or interview. The District Administration reserves the right to shortlist candidates, modify the schedule or cancel the recruitment process, subject to applicable Government guidelines. Candidates shall provide a valid mobile number and e-mail ID for communication regarding the selection process. The decision of the competent authority regarding selection shall be final.
